## Result and exact scope

This records a complete counterexample to the abstract ordered-pair compact-alphabet question in Felipe Gonçalves's Question 1, Oberwolfach Report 22/2023, p.1254.

The game has a compact connected alphabet, continuous positive size, a closed tile relation, an attained minimum, and dense periodic competitors. Every minimizer is aperiodic. The construction is a continuous family of circle rotations with angle √2+t and cost 1+t.

The separately structured interval-packing problem and Gonçalves–Vedana Conjecture 4 are **not resolved**. No historical-priority, first-resolution, or novel-method claim is made.
